author: Ljungman, 1872

note.en: A tiny brittle star with five arms, known here from museum specimens. Disc size is an approximate field-guide value.
note.es: Una ofiura diminuta de cinco brazos, conocida aquí por especímenes de museo. El tamaño del disco es un valor aproximado de guías de campo.

evidence: GBIF: 8 records in the region (many are museum specimens)

sources.t: WoRMS: World Register of Marine Species, accepted name and range

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 8 records in the region (many are museum specimens).

photos.by: Gondim A, Dias T, Christoffersen M (2013) Annotated checklist of Echinoderms from Maranhão and Piauí States, Northeastern Brazil. Check List 9(3): 510-518

marks.en: Tiny brittle star with a small disc and slim arms, hiding in rubble and crevices.
marks.es: Ofiura diminuta de disco pequeño y brazos delgados, escondida entre cascajo y grietas.
